entries.title: Your own scripts can wake your first mate
entries.body: Turn on the Infinitary Inbox in Settings, Integrations, and any script or terminal on this computer can drop a short note into it, such as a finished deploy or a failed backup. The script gets a receipt at once, and your first mate reads each note as information from outside, never as an instruction, and decides what it needs.

picture.alt: Settings, Integrations with the Infinitary Inbox section at the top, its switch on, an example line a script runs with a Copy example button, and the rule that wakes the first mate.
